patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed, deep purple background across all pages, creating a consistent, immersive dark mode aesthetic.
Content is primarily organized into distinct, rounded-corner cards, often featuring an image at the top and text below, for deals, destinations, and feature explanations.
A vibrant orange is consistently used as the primary accent color for calls to action, interactive elements, and key highlights against the dark background.
The top navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and adjusting its internal layout (e.g., logo size, addition of 'Ask AI' button) after the initial hero section.
A subtle, contextual tooltip or toast message appears at the bottom right of the screen after a certain scroll depth on the homepage.
Informational sections, particularly on interior pages, integrate playful Lottie animations alongside text to explain features and concepts.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky header that initially occupies a larger space and then smoothly transitions to a reduced height with a solid background and potentially rearranged elements (like a smaller logo or added buttons) once the user scrolls past the hero section.

Design the entire user interface with a deep, dark background color and use high-contrast light text, reserving a single vibrant color for primary calls to action, interactive elements, and key highlights.

Structure content into distinct, self-contained cards with consistent rounded corners, often featuring an image at the top and descriptive text below, to visually segment information and improve scannability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) provide clear hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and occasional uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded corners are consistently applied to cards, buttons, and input fields, creating a soft and friendly feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and consistent, moderate spacing within card grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, immersive dark purple background combined with vibrant orange accents creates a sophisticated yet energetic feel. The integration of playful Lottie animations on interior pages, alongside a highly functional, card-based content structure, sets it apart from typical travel booking sites that often opt for lighter, more utilitarian designs.
